text:
sara: Heads-up — planning to run a schema change during the 01:00 UTC change window: add a sharded index on events and backfill existing rows. Canary first (1 shard), then widen if metrics stable. I'll update release notes and pin client to v2.9.0 for canary.
ali: thanks. is the backfill online/concurrent? rough runtime estimate?
sara: yes, CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY on events(shard_id, created_at). Backfill estimate ~2h for full dataset, but canary shard <10m. we'll throttle via job queue. SQL snippet:
```sql
SET statement_timeout = 0;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_shard_created ON events (shard_id, created_at);
``` 
mike: can we set maintenance_work_mem low and limit workers? prefer not to spike IO. recommend max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0 for the maintenance session.
ali: agree. also want pg_stat_activity watchdog and an early abort if lock wait > 30s. we should run on a replica first to validate speed profile.
jen: I'll own rollback/escape hatch. Plan if anything goes sideways: 1) pause backfill job queue 2) revert app pin to v2.8.7 (clients stop using new index), 3) if index corrupted or causing bloat, DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_shard_created, 4) restore stats and re-plan. Keep SQL for rollback handy.
sara: adding rollout steps to release notes now and attaching the migration doc. Also tagging @ali @mike for DB knobs. Ops oncall please standby at 00:45 UTC.
deploybot: deploy queued: migration/1769891234 -> canary shard api-0. Canary start requested by sara. Rolling out service pin v2.9.0 to canary host set.
infra-bot: preflight checklist: replicas warmed, snapshot created (s3://redwood-migrations/1769891234-snap), alert rules set (index_backfill_latency, long_tx_lock). Auto-scale pre-warm +2 GPU nodes if CPU > 70%.
mike: running a dry-run on staging now, will post timings. also adding a short smoke test to verify event queries hit the new index (EXPLAIN ANALYZE + index scan) before widening.
ali: one more ask — can we enable a temporary feature flag to force-fallthrough to legacy path if errors spike? easier than a full revert.
jen: yes feature flag ready. toggle path: `ff.events.index_new=false` — rollback will flip this first.
deploybot: canary complete: index created on shard-3, backfill rows: 12. latency delta +3% p95, error rate unchanged. Monitoring window open for 15m.
sara: good signal. waiting 15m then widen to 4 shards if stable. leaving notes in the release doc about the pin and rollback steps.
mike: staging dry-run showed similar +2-4% p95, good to widen. I'll watch DB locks during widen.
jen: oncall ready. if anything goes >5% error or long lock waits, we'll trigger rollback and open a postmortem thread.
sara: thanks everyone. I'll post a short release note blurb and the final rollout timeline in #release-notes after widen.
